name: Model Market
intro: Bringing Lewisham's Model Market back to life after five years: German Kraft runs the revived 1950s market at Lewisham Shopping Centre for Landsec, as an all-day hub for street food, makers, events and our own taproom.

sections.title: Press & P.R.
sections.text: The announcement in June 2026 made the market's return a London story, from Time Out to The Caterer.

press_teaser.label: All press coverage
press_teaser.heading: Most of the press coverage came through our PR agency, Jukebox.

sections.text: The revived Model Market identity, carried through the trader deck we used to sign the food vendors: retro lettering, hand-drawn illustrations and the market's orange.
Pre-opening and first-year marketing built against the P&L: a trader call-out, newsletter, Instagram, PR, launch events and outdoor.
